name: City name
allowed_value_shape: Text; normally direct. Unreachable only if case identity genuinely cannot be established.
decision_rule: Use the full official city/municipality/service-area name applicable to the programme. Do not substitute a nearby city or metro label.
evidence_requirement: Official programme/municipal source identifying the service geography.
inference_rule: No inference normally.

name: Country
allowed_value_shape: Full country name.
decision_rule: Code the country containing the target programme/service geography. This is retained for identity/provenance even if not read by the analysis pipeline.
inference_rule: Geographic inference from an unambiguous official city/state identity is allowed; explain only if needed.

name: Population & year
allowed_value_shape: Number + reference year + exact geography; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Prefer the most recent authoritative census/official estimate appropriate to the programme geography. Preserve the reference year and distinguish municipality/city proper from metro/other geography. Do not silently substitute geographies.
evidence_requirement: Official census/statistical source; quote/table/field and URL.
inference_rule: Do not invent population arithmetically. If only an alternate geography is defensibly usable, mark [proxy] and explain.

name: Köppen climate zone
allowed_value_shape: Canonical 3-letter Köppen-Geiger code; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Use the study-fixed Köppen-Geiger source/version where possible, at city/location level. Programme-document silence is irrelevant to this contextual variable. If the incumbent has a substantive three-letter code, search the dedicated Köppen-Geiger/scientific classification evidence before considering any downgrade. Where sources conflict, prefer the frozen study source/version and correct to another substantive class if that source establishes it; do not convert a source conflict into `Not stated`.
evidence_requirement: Fixed/peer-reviewed Köppen-Geiger classification source with location and version. A reputable secondary location reference may be retained as supporting provenance when the fixed source is temporarily inaccessible, but should trigger a targeted fixed-source lookup rather than automatic deletion.
inference_rule: No free-form climate inference if a classification lookup exists.

name: Urban land-use mix
allowed_value_shape: Multi-select: High-rise residential; Low-rise residential; Mixed-use; Industrial/peri-urban; Other -- specify; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Select all categories that materially characterise the programme area. For citywide schemes, use authoritative planning/spatial evidence of dominant/relevant forms; do not infer solely from programme type.
evidence_requirement: Official planning/land-use/spatial source plus programme geography evidence.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed when mapping/planning evidence must be translated into the analytical categories.

name: Urban density (inh/km²)
allowed_value_shape: Published numeric density or [calculated]; reference year/geography; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Prefer authoritative published density for the exact geography. If unavailable, calculate from authoritative population and land area only when they refer to exactly the same geography.
evidence_requirement: Official density source OR official population + land-area sources; show formula/conversion.
inference_rule: [calculated] allowed; never label arithmetic [inferred]. [proxy] only for an explicit alternate geography.

name: Topography
allowed_value_shape: Concise physical-setting category/detail; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Describe physical topographic/geographic setting relevant to the city/programme area (e.g. low-lying floodplain, coastal plain, steep valley slopes). Do not code hazard effects here.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed when authoritative physical evidence is synthesised into a concise topographic description.

name: Hazard exposure
allowed_value_shape: Documented hazards/exposure context; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Record actual spatial hazard/exposure context, not merely the programme objective. Keep distinct from B-5/B-6.
evidence_requirement: Authoritative hazard maps/plans/official risk material relevant to the city/programme area.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only where official hazard evidence necessarily establishes exposure.

name: Official URL(s)
allowed_value_shape: Semicolon-separated applicable official URLs; Unreachable only if no applicable official source can be recovered.
decision_rule: List the official programme/controlling URLs actually applicable to this case. Remove stale/wrong-programme/duplicate links. This field is provenance even if not read analytically.
evidence_requirement: Official programme, rules, application and controlling sources.
inference_rule: No substantive inference; applicability must be established.

name: Programme name
allowed_value_shape: Full official name, original language; English translation in brackets if useful.
decision_rule: Use the exact target programme name. Do not replace with an umbrella initiative or successor/predecessor unless that is the case definition.
inference_rule: No inference normally.

name: Year launched
allowed_value_shape: YYYY; if genuinely uncertain use concise qualified year; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Use the year the target programme was publicly launched/formally adopted, not the oldest related policy or the date of a successor scheme.
inference_rule: [inferred] only when an authoritative dated document necessarily bounds/establishes launch; explain.

name: Lead body
allowed_value_shape: Organisation name + category {Municipality | Utility | NGO/Partnership | Other}; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Identify the organisation with primary programme responsibility, not every partner.
evidence_requirement: Programme rules/page naming the administering/lead organisation.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only if governance documents clearly assign responsibility.

name: Main objective
allowed_value_shape: Stormwater | Heat | Biodiversity | Drought/Water conservation | Amenity | Multiple -- list; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Code the primary official programme objective. Use Multiple only when official framing gives multiple objectives comparable weight. Do not infer every ecosystem co-benefit as an objective.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed when purpose is necessarily evident from controlling programme rules, but prefer direct framing.

name: Hazards addressed
allowed_value_shape: Multi-select: Stormwater/flood; Urban heat; Air quality; Drought; Erosion; Coastal; Biodiversity loss; None stated/Not stated is NOT a combined state; use Not stated for silence; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Record hazards explicitly addressed or necessarily established by programme purpose/design. Do not assign all theoretical co-benefits of green infrastructure.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only where programme design necessarily targets the hazard; explain.

name: Spatial targeting
allowed_value_shape: Citywide | Priority zones -- specify | Watershed/sewershed -- specify | Equity/vulnerability zones -- specify | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Citywide requires affirmative jurisdiction-wide applicability. Do not infer Citywide merely because no priority zone was found.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only from affirmative geographic eligibility language.

name: Lead department named
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- name | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes when a specific responsible organisational unit is named for the programme: department, division, office, team or equivalent administrative unit. Do not require the source to literally use the word “department”. An individual role alone is insufficient unless the surrounding governance evidence also identifies the responsible unit. No requires explicit/exhaustive evidence that no unit is designated; otherwise Not stated after the required search.
evidence_requirement: Official programme governance material. Where a coordinator/manager role is named, search the surrounding governance document and related official programme material for the organisational unit behind that role before considering Not stated.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed for an unambiguous equivalent organisational unit. No from silence prohibited.

name: Multi-department involvement
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- list departments | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only when at least two named departments/agencies are actually involved in programme governance/delivery, not merely mentioned elsewhere.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Coordination office/body
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- name | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only for an explicitly named coordination office/body or clearly designated coordinating mechanism.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Delivery partners
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- list | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only for explicitly named utilities, NGOs, contractors or partner organisations involved in delivery. Distinguish delivery partners from funders or generic supporters.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Technical standards cited
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- specify | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes if specific technical codes, design specifications or formal standards apply to the supported intervention. Generic advice is insufficient.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Permit fast-track
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only if expedited/priority permit processing is explicitly provided for programme participants. A fee waiver is not a fast-track.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Permit fee waiver
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only if relevant permit fees are waived/reduced for programme participants. Keep separate from fast-track.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Homeowners eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Owner-occupiers/homeowners count when explicitly or necessarily included. No only by explicit exclusion or exhaustive eligibility rule.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed from exhaustive eligibility definitions; silence never implies No.

name: Landlords eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Residential/commercial landlords/property owners who may participate as landlords. Do not assume homeowner eligibility automatically proves landlord eligibility unless the rule covers all property owners.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed from exhaustive/general property-owner wording when logically applicable.

name: Tenants eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- direct | Yes [conditional] -- owner/landlord consent required | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes = tenant may independently participate. Yes [conditional] = tenant route exists but requires owner/landlord consent/signature/equivalent property control. No = explicit exclusion or exhaustive owner-only rule. Generic residency/account conditions are not owner-permission conditions.
inference_rule: No [inferred] allowed only from demonstrably exhaustive rule. Silence never implies No.

name: Co-ops/HOAs eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Covers condominium associations, VvEs, housing cooperatives/HOAs or equivalent collective property bodies.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed from an unambiguous equivalent legal category.

name: Schools eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Include public/private schools only when eligibility applies. Do not infer from generic "institutions" unless the source context makes schools necessarily included.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only when category equivalence is secure.

name: NGOs eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Registered nonprofits/civic societies or equivalent.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed from unambiguous nonprofit/civil-society category wording.

name: SMEs eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Commercial properties/businesses count where the programme permits them. Do not assume all commercial applicants are SMEs if size is material; state the actual category.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed where business/commercial eligibility necessarily covers SMEs.

name: Social housing providers eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Public housing agencies, housing associations or social-housing providers.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed from unambiguous equivalent legal/institutional category.

name: Informal groups eligible
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only where groups without formal legal entity status can participate. Ordinary community organisations with legal status do not automatically count.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited; inference must establish informal/unincorporated status.

name: Step-by-step/applicant guide
allowed_value_shape: Yes | Partial | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes = materially complete applicant pathway (eligibility/application plus what to do/submission/order and material next steps). It need not be literally numbered. Partial = useful but materially incomplete, fragmented, or professional-only. No only with authoritative/exhaustive evidence of absence.
inference_rule: No [inferred] only from a genuinely exhaustive official application package; silence = Not stated.

name: Timelines stated
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- duration/deadline | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only if specific applicant/process durations, deadlines or decision periods are documented. A programme end date alone is not necessarily a procedural timeline.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Forms accessible
allowed_value_shape: Yes | Partial | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes = all material application/order/registration mechanisms needed to participate are accessible. An operational online order/registration portal counts when it is the actual participation mechanism. Partial = only some required elements accessible. No = required mechanism affirmatively unavailable.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Application channels
allowed_value_shape: Multi-select fixed order: Online form; Email; Paper/mail; Third-party portal; In-person; Other -- specify; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Code actual participation/application channels only. A generic enquiry email/contact page is not an application channel.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only if the operational mechanism clearly functions as the application route.

name: Language availability
allowed_value_shape: ISO-style language codes in fixed order; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Record languages in which official programme/application materials are actually available. Do not infer from national multilingualism.
evidence_requirement: Official programme documents/pages in those languages.
inference_rule: No inference from country/language policy.

name: Co-design
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only for participatory programme design, formal consultation, citizen steering or comparable design-stage involvement. Information sessions/marketing/application assistance do not equal co-design.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Tenant pathway
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes requires a tenant-specific route/mechanism/form/landlord-consent pathway. General tenant eligibility alone does not automatically establish a pathway.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed where a clearly defined owner-consent mechanism constitutes the pathway.

name: Housing-type guidance
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only where guidance materially differentiates housing/property types. Being open to multiple property types is insufficient.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Green roofs
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only if green roofs are actually funded/supported by this programme, not merely mentioned as environmentally beneficial.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Green façades
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Includes supported climbing plants, living walls or vertical greening. Must be programme-supported.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Rain gardens/bioretention
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Includes bioswales where the programme supports them as bioretention/rain-garden-type measures.
inference_rule: Category inference allowed from unambiguous equivalent measure wording.

name: Permeable paving/depaving
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Includes permeable pavers, gravel/crushed stone replacing impermeable surfaces, or depaving where supported.
inference_rule: Category inference allowed from unambiguous equivalent measure wording.

name: Trees/tree pits
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Supported trees/tree pits on eligible private/public-interface land. Do not code generic municipal tree planting if outside the target programme.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Rain barrels/cisterns
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Any supported rainwater storage vessel; conversions count only when confirmed as storage under this programme.
inference_rule: Category inference allowed from unambiguous equivalent storage terminology.

name: Other supported practices
allowed_value_shape: Free text list of additional supported measures; None -- only if exhaustive absence established; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: List measures not already captured by E-1 to E-6, such as infiltration pits, downspout disconnection, native planting, courtyard greening. Do not duplicate E-1-E-6.
inference_rule: None requires affirmative/exhaustive evidence; silence = Not stated.

name: Capital grant
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- amount/currency/basis | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Direct cash grant/subsidy toward capital installation. State amount, currency, percentage, cap and unit as documented. A discounted purchase belongs in E-11 unless a separate cash grant exists.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Tax rebate / fee credit
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- type/detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Property-tax reduction, stormwater/utility bill credit or comparable fiscal rebate. Keep distinct from a direct grant.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Low-interest loan
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- rate/terms | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only for an actual loan/financing mechanism; state rate if documented. Generic financing language is insufficient.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Lump-sum/discounted purchase
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- subsidised price/discount | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: One-off payment/discounted product sale or similar subsidised purchase. Distinguish from E-8 cash grant.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Behavioural reward
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- type | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Explicit non-monetary incentive such as recognition, certification, competition, award or label. Ordinary advertising is not a behavioural reward.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Technical advice
allowed_value_shape: Guides; Helpdesk; Site visits; fixed-order combinations; None; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Record the actual documented PROGRAMME TECHNICAL-ADVICE types. Do not use vague "Multiple types". `Guides` means technical guidance about supported measures/design/selection/implementation/installation or relevant maintenance, not merely application instructions (which belong under D-1). `Helpdesk` requires programme-linked technical guidance or consultation about the intervention; generic application, IT, login, submission-platform, vendor, or portal support does NOT count even when labelled "Technical Assistance". `Site visits` require programme-linked on-site technical advice/assessment. None is substantive absence and requires affirmative/exhaustive evidence; Not stated is silence.
evidence_requirement: Programme-specific technical guide/helpdesk/site-visit offer. The decisive evidence span and its local context must tie the service to the target programme and to technical guidance about the supported intervention. Generic navigation/footer/platform support is insufficient.
inference_rule: Category inference allowed from clear equivalent PROGRAMME TECHNICAL service descriptions. Administrative/application/IT support cannot be inferred into technical advice.

name: Other instruments
allowed_value_shape: Free text list; None -- only if exhaustive absence established; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Other programme support instruments not captured by E-8 to E-13. Avoid duplicates.
inference_rule: None requires affirmative/exhaustive evidence.

name: Maintenance grant
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- amount/duration | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Cash specifically for post-installation maintenance. Installation/capital funding is not maintenance funding merely because maintenance is later required.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Ongoing maintenance covered
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | Yes [inferred] -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes where programme/public support covers ongoing maintenance either financially or by directly providing the ongoing maintenance service in kind. A mere obligation placed on the participant is not coverage. Assignment of maintenance responsibility to the public programme/operator may support Yes [inferred] when, in programme context, it clearly means that the public body provides the maintenance service.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed for direct in-kind public maintenance provision. No from silence prohibited.

name: Maintenance as condition
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- duration/condition | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes where maintenance is an explicit participation/funding obligation; state duration if known. Do not infer merely because infrastructure should function.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed if rules unambiguously impose maintenance duties even without the exact phrase.

name: Non-financial maintenance support
allowed_value_shape: Guides; Helpdesk; Site visits; Inspection reminders; fixed-order combinations; None; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Record actual post-installation non-financial maintenance support. None is substantive absence requiring affirmative/exhaustive evidence; Not stated is silence.
inference_rule: Category inference allowed from clear equivalent support descriptions.

name: Maximum public contribution
allowed_value_shape: Amount/currency + cap/basis; or percentage with no absolute cap stated; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Record the maximum documented public contribution, including currency, unit, percentage and cap. Never invent an absolute cap.
inference_rule: [calculated] allowed only for deterministic conversion of stated units/currencies if study rules permit; preserve original amount.

name: Incentive basis
allowed_value_shape: Flat per intervention | % of eligible costs | Per m²/unit | Custom/project-specific | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Code how support amount is calculated. Utility-fee credits may be Custom/project-specific if not a project-cost percentage.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed when transaction formula necessarily establishes the category.

name: Eligible cost types
allowed_value_shape: Fixed order multi-select: Design/planning; Installation; Permitting; Maintenance; Monitoring; Other -- specify; None -- only if explicit; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: Tick only cost categories explicitly or necessarily eligible. A product subsidy does not imply all possible cost types.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only where a named reimbursable item maps unambiguously to a canonical category.

name: Disbursement timing
allowed_value_shape: Upfront (before install) | Milestone-based | Reimbursement after install | Ongoing fiscal credit (bill reduction) | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Code the functional timing/mechanism. Reimbursement means participant pays first then claims. Upfront includes subsidised purchase/order before installation and direct in-kind public supply/installation where the programme provides the supported item/service without the participant first paying and claiming reimbursement. Keep the canonical `Upfront (before install)` prefix for analysis compatibility and explain direct in-kind provision in the qualifier.
evidence_requirement: Payment/order/claim rules or direct programme supply/installation rules.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed when transaction or in-kind delivery structure necessarily establishes the timing; explain.

name: Funding source
allowed_value_shape: Municipal budget | Utility/stormwater fee | State/national grant | Donor/foundation | Mixed | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Code the actual funding source, not every delivery partner. Mixed only when multiple sources finance the programme.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only where official budget/fee structure clearly funds the programme.

name: Funding horizon
allowed_value_shape: Recurring annual | Fixed-term -- end date | Pilot | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Recurring annual requires affirmative recurrence evidence. "Currently open" alone is insufficient.
inference_rule: No inference from present availability alone.

name: Cost coverage scope
allowed_value_shape: Concise free text; Not stated; Unreachable.
decision_rule: State what costs/support are covered and excluded. Do not expand beyond documented coverage.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only where coverage follows necessarily from an explicit product/service subsidy.

name: M&E indicators published
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- list indicators | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only if specific measurable programme indicators are published or explicitly defined (e.g. m² installed, litres retained, number of interventions). Aspirational objectives are insufficient.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Public reporting type
allowed_value_shape: Open-data portal | PDF report | Webpage summary | Not publicly reported | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Not publicly reported is substantive and requires evidence that reporting is not public; Not stated is documentary silence.
inference_rule: No collapse between Not publicly reported and Not stated.

name: Periodic review stated
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- schedule | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only for an actual stated review/evaluation schedule or recurrent review mechanism. Programme activity alone does not qualify.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Feedback channel
allowed_value_shape: Phone -- detail | Email -- detail | Web form -- detail | App -- detail | Other -- detail | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Use a specific programme participant feedback/contact mechanism. Generic municipal contact details are insufficient unless explicitly tied to the programme.
inference_rule: No inference from generic city contact.

name: Maintenance responsibility
allowed_value_shape: Applicant/participant | City/utility | Shared | Contractor | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Code who is documented as responsible for long-term maintenance. Keep responsibility distinct from funding/support.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed when duties unambiguously assign responsibility.

name: Informal groups acknowledged
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only where programme explicitly recognises/accommodates groups without formal legal status. "Community" alone is insufficient.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Tenant pathway (equity lens)
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Use the same underlying evidence as D-7 where applicable, but code the equity-pathway construct. Note owner permission where relevant. Do not contradict C-10/D-7 without source reason.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed where a clearly defined permission pathway exists.

name: Civil society in design
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only for civil-society/citizen participation in programme design/governance, not simply participation as applicants/beneficiaries.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Equity/priority targeting
allowed_value_shape: Citywide | Hazard-exposure zones -- specify | Low-income/equity zones -- specify | Vulnerable populations -- specify | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Code affirmative equity/priority targeting. Do not infer Citywide merely because no priority area is mentioned.
inference_rule: [inferred] allowed only from affirmative jurisdiction-wide or priority-area eligibility evidence.

name: Equity indicators tracked
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- indicators | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only if demographic, distributional, vulnerability or equity outcomes are explicitly tracked. Ordinary programme output totals are not equity indicators.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.

name: Informal action acknowledged
allowed_value_shape: Yes -- detail | No | Not stated | Unreachable.
decision_rule: Yes only where informal/self-organised action such as guerrilla gardening, informal greening or comparable practices is explicitly recognised. Ordinary citizen participation is insufficient.
inference_rule: No from silence prohibited.
